goal: Refuse single-file CLI conversion when the output resolves to the same filesystem object as its input, before prompting or opening the writer.
plan_scope: P6 CLI and oracle contracts: exact overwrite admission and namespace/collision checks

reproduction.input: 131-byte DXF authored from scratch in a temporary directory; SHA-256 1cea781dbabd037786b78c23ad01b4121c6525771bcf6f893b4a29aab2d574f2
reproduction.observed_effect: Input changed from 131 bytes to 10068 bytes and the original LINE was absent from the resulting file.

implementation.summary: Before overwrite authorization, compare existing input/output filesystem identity with std::filesystem::equivalent; refuse aliases, fail closed if identity cannot be checked, and keep the source bytes unchanged.
implementation.behavior: convertFile checks std::filesystem::equivalent before overwrite prompting; same-file, symlink and hard-link aliases are refused, and identity-check errors fail closed.
implementation.tests_added: Generated temporary aliases exercise positional overwrite, FreeCAD -o overwrite, and positional no-overwrite routes. On this host, same-path, symlink and hard-link aliases each pass through all three routes (9 refusal cases). No fixture files were added.

escalation: This local CLI identity guard does not qualify cross-platform filesystem behavior, atomic publication against concurrent path replacement, or broader output semantics. No full suite or independent format oracle is needed for this slice.
